questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L P_ S T _ _ Q _T L _ _ S T
questions.solution:
Given :- L P_ S T _ _ Q _T L _ _ S T

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) QLPSPQ → L P **Q** S T - **L P** Q **S** T - L** P Q** S T

 
• Here **"LPQST"** is repeated.

2) PQSLSP → L P **P** S T - **Q S** Q **L** T - L **S P** S T

3) PQLQLP → L P **P** S T - **Q L** Q **Q** T - L **L P** S T

4) LQPQSP → L P **L** S T - **Q P** Q **Q** T - L **S P** S T

 
• Option (3) gives the pattern of :- L P Q S T - L P Q S T - L P Q S T

Hence, the correct answer is **"QLPSPQ".**

questions.question: Manoj starts from his home and reaches the temple in 7 hours. He travels 1/4 th of the total distance at a speed of 10 km/h and the remaining distance at 12 km/h. Find the distance between his home and the temple.
questions.solution:
Given,

Manoj starts from his home and reaches the temple in 7 hours.

⇒ Total time taken = 7 hours.

He travels 1/4 th of the total distance at a speed of 10 km/h and the remaining distance at 12 km/h.

Total distance = 4x km.

**Total time taken = D₁/S₁ + D₂/S₂ **

He travels 1/4 th of the total distance at a speed of 10 km/h.

D₁ = 4x/4 = x km

D₂ = 4x - x = 3x km

S₁ = 10 km/h

S₂ = 12 km/h.

∴ Total time taken = D1/S1 + D2/S2 

⇒ 7 = x/10 + 3x/12

⇒ 7 = x/10 + x/4

LCM of 10, 4 is 20

⇒ 7 = (2x + 5x)/20

⇒ 7 = 7x/20

⇒ x = 20 

∴ The total distance = 4x = 4 × 20 = 80 km

Hence, the correct answer is **"80 km".**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘addition’, ‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication’, ‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘division’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

483 D 23 A 93 C 16 B 4
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47370b0626128df212f2edfaa682c86866fe2d62d3725f3ea6cf4f4de186cf14.png] 

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 **Operators**
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

Given expression : 483 D 23 A 93 C 16 B 4 

After replacing mathematical operators in place of alphabets the expression is as follows : 483 ÷ 23 + 93 - 16 × 4

= __**483 ÷ 23**__ + 93 - 16 × 4

= 21 + 93 - __**16 × 4**__

= __**21 + 93**__ - 64

= __**114 - 64**__

**= 50**

Hence, the correct answer is **"50".**
